description: The grading backlog: pending (ungraded or unresolved) answers grouped by the epoch they came from, oldest first, with count, age of the oldest, stale flag, seals-to-quorum histogram (0, 1, 2, 3, 4+, unknown), expiry close and its estimated time, and per close the settlement origin, rows that grew without settling and silent drops. Use it for backlog and queue questions. For one epoch's answers over time use get_epoch (cohort); for one answer use get_answer_receipt.
name: get_pending_by_epoch
title: Pending by epoch
